quests.dispatcherQuestion: A man has collapsed on the sidewalk and is not moving. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Name the vehicle that carries paramedics.
quests.explanation: An ambulance brings trained paramedics who can check him and start treatment right away.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Thick smoke is pouring from a neighbor's kitchen window. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Name the service that puts out fires.
quests.explanation: The fire brigade has the equipment and training needed to put out a house fire safely.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Two men are breaking into a parked car outside the shop. Input police code!
quests.hint: Name the service that responds to crime.
quests.explanation: Police officers are trained to respond to a crime in progress and keep bystanders safe.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A child is choking on a piece of food at dinner. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Ask for help urgently, using the word 'now'.
quests.explanation: Paramedics are trained to clear a blocked airway and can arrive within minutes.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Someone is trying to force open the back door of a house. Input police code!
quests.hint: Ask for a police vehicle already on the road.
quests.explanation: A break-in in progress needs police to arrive quickly and safely stop the intruder.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A small fire has started in an office wastebasket. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Name the vehicle firefighters arrive in.
quests.explanation: A fire engine carries firefighters and equipment that can put out even a small fire before it spreads.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A woman is having a severe allergic reaction and her face is swelling. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Ask plainly for someone trained to treat them.
quests.explanation: A severe allergic reaction can become dangerous fast, so trained medical help must be sent immediately.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A strong smell of gas is coming from a kitchen stove. Input safety code!
quests.hint: Get everyone out before anything else.
quests.explanation: Getting everyone outside first removes the risk of an explosion or breathing in the gas.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A student has fainted in the school hallway. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Ask for the medical team by name.
quests.explanation: An ambulance crew can check why she fainted and treat her safely on the scene.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A driver has hit a lamp post and looks hurt. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Ask for the medical team, and add urgency.
quests.explanation: Adding 'now' tells the operator this cannot wait, so help is sent at top priority.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Flames are visible on the stove in a family kitchen. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Ask for the team that puts out fires.
quests.explanation: A trained fire crew can put out a stove fire safely without it spreading further.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A man's wallet has just been snatched on the street. Input police code!
quests.hint: Let the police know what you're seeing.
quests.explanation: Reporting a theft right away gives police the best chance of catching the person nearby.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A worker has fallen from a short ladder and can't stand up. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Ask plainly for trained help to be sent.
quests.explanation: A fall can cause injuries that aren't visible, so trained paramedics should check him quickly.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Someone is shouting for help from inside a locked, smoke-filled room. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Let the local fire team know right away.
quests.explanation: The fire station can send a crew equipped to enter safely and reach the person.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A shoplifter is running out of a store with stolen goods. Input police code!
quests.hint: Send the service that handles this kind of incident.
quests.explanation: A dispatched unit can follow up quickly while the direction the person ran is still known.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A toddler has swallowed a small button battery. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Formally ask for the ambulance to be sent.
quests.explanation: Swallowed batteries can cause serious internal harm quickly, so a trip to hospital by ambulance is safest.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Sparks are coming from an electrical socket in a bedroom. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Name the department responsible for fire risks.
quests.explanation: Firefighters can check for hidden wiring damage and put out any resulting fire safely.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A masked person is seen climbing through a neighbor's window. Input police code!
quests.hint: Send an official police vehicle to the scene.
quests.explanation: A masked person entering through a window is a strong sign of a break-in, so police must be alerted fast.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: An elderly man has fallen at home and cannot get up. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Ask for the vehicle that carries paramedics to come.
quests.explanation: A fall in an older adult may cause a fracture, so trained medical help should check him.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A bin fire outside a restaurant is spreading toward the wall. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Ask for the vehicles firefighters arrive in, urgently.
quests.explanation: Acting quickly stops a small outdoor fire from spreading and damaging the building.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A woman reports her purse was grabbed by a passing cyclist. Input police code!
quests.hint: Ask for the police, and stress the urgency.
quests.explanation: A nearby patrol car can respond fastest and may still catch sight of the cyclist.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A boy has a deep cut on his leg from broken glass. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Send help trained to treat injuries.
quests.explanation: A deep cut can bleed heavily, so trained medical help should reach him quickly.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A candle has set the curtains alight in a living room. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Send the official service trained to fight fires.
quests.explanation: Curtain fires spread fast, so the fire brigade must be called the moment it's spotted.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A man is seen forcing open a car door in a parking lot. Input police code!
quests.hint: Ask for police, and stress the urgency.
quests.explanation: A car break-in in progress needs a quick police response before the suspect leaves the area.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A woman is struggling to breathe during an asthma attack. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Say who needs to reach the patient quickly.
quests.explanation: Paramedics carry oxygen and medicine that can ease breathing within minutes of arriving.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A small kitchen fire has spread to a nearby towel. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Say who's needed, and stress the urgency.
quests.explanation: Even a small spreading fire needs a properly equipped crew to make sure it's fully out.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A child is reported missing from the playground. Input police code!
quests.hint: Say who's needed, and where.
quests.explanation: Police can begin a search immediately, and every early minute matters when a child is missing.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A man is clutching his chest and says he feels crushing pain. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Ask for the vehicle that can treat him on the way to hospital.
quests.explanation: Chest pain like this can be a heart attack, so an ambulance must be sent immediately.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Flames are climbing the outside wall of a garden shed. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Name who should respond, and add urgency.
quests.explanation: A shed fire can spread to a house quickly, so the fire station needs to know at once.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A driver reports someone following her closely and acting aggressively. Input police code!
quests.hint: Ask for the extra support officers need.
quests.explanation: A dispatched unit can reach her quickly and make sure she gets home safely.
